comments.body:
I did my masters thesis with a US organization, jointly supervised by a computer science lab here.

It was my responsibility to find an overseas supervisor who wanted to work with me. Then I wrote up a pitch and found a lab that wanted to work on this with me. In my case, I looked for an ETh supervisor at an NLP lab and at a lab generally known to work with many self-proposed theses (DISCO lab).

Beware that your thesis process will probably have to be more self-directed, as you will need to satisfy requirements from both sides.

Best of luck.
comments.author: elber3th
